prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a rear-end collision. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1353; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with reported head impact and immediate post-traumatic symptoms consistent with concussion. The mechanism of injury and the force involved are well matched to the injuries described at intake. Neurological examination and imaging findings clearly confirm the diagnosis of concussion with post-concussive symptoms including headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Patient has no known prior injury to the head or neck. Care was delivered over 27 visits, which is somewhat longer than typical for this injury, with gradual progression through vestibular therapy, graded return to activity, and symptom monitoring. Symptoms improved steadily over the course of care, though recovery was slower in the later weeks. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated billing entries. Patient is currently improving and is expected to continue a home exercise program with follow-up as needed.
